versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Huawei Cloud ECS monitoring skill using Cloud Eye Service (CES).
- Supports real-time monitoring and historical metrics query for ECS instances (CPU, memory, disk, network, system metrics).
- Default and fallback logic between SYS.ECS (agentless) and AGT.ECS (agent-based) metric namespaces.
- Enforces secure credential handling and IAM permission checks before any operation.
- Includes workflow for listing ECS instances, querying common and advanced metrics, and handling insufficient permission errors.
